name: TeamHealth (2nd Position)
desc:
Patient Accounts Representative | Est. $18/hr | Payment Posting and Billing, No Sales Expectations
Company: TeamHealth
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
TeamHealth is the largest physician practice in the U.S. In this behind-the-scenes billing role, you'll post insurance and patient payments, both electronically and by hand, for your assigned regions. You'll post payment batches and insurance denials on deadline, check that each batch matches the day's deposits, and keep reports and production logs up to date. When insurance denies or rejects a claim, you'll record that information so the follow-up team can act on it. It's detail-focused computer work with a team, not a phone-heavy job.

Soft Skills
- Attention to detail and accuracy
- Organization and time management
- Meeting deadlines
- Working well with a team
- Positive, can-do attitude
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: Knowledge of coordination of benefits requirements and cash posting rules
Preferred Experience: 6+ months of medical billing experience and experience with insurance denials, rejections, and follow-up

Required Skills:
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Organization, prioritizing, and time management
- Handling multiple tasks on deadline
- Clear verbal and written communication
- Customer-focused and collaborative
- Works efficiently and independently in a fast-paced setting

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has medical billing or payment posting experience
- Has a medical billing certificate or coursework
- Likes numbers and making things balance
- Prefers computer work over phone calls

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has no medical billing knowledge at all
- Struggles with accuracy or details
- Wants a people-facing, phone-based job
- Has trouble meeting daily deadlines
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Payment posting
- Cash posting
- Medical billing
- Insurance denials and rejections
- Coordination of benefits
- Batch reconciliation
- Revenue cycle
- EOB review
- Accuracy and attention to detail
- Production logs and reporting

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your medical billing or payment posting experience.
- What is coordination of benefits, and why does it matter?
- Your payment batch doesn't match the day's deposit. What do you do?
- Tell us about a time you caught an error before it caused a problem. What happened, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you had a tight deadline. How did you manage it, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: Est. $15.71 to $20.22/hr, working estimate $18/hr. Pay isn't listed in this posting. A recent TeamHealth Patient Accounts Representative posting in Alcoa, TN listed $32,682 to $42,065 a year, which is about $15.71 to $20.22/hr. Exact pay will be discussed in interview/offer stage.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision starting the first of the month after 30 days, 401(k) with discretionary match, generous PTO, and 8 paid holidays.
-Equipment Provided: Yes, for eligible remote positions.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: A good next step for participants with medical billing training or experience who want a no-phone, detail-focused remote job. Benefits start quickly, after about 30 days. Knowing coordination of benefits and cash posting rules is listed, so a medical billing certificate helps. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Patient Accounts Representative → Senior Patient Accounts Representative → Billing Team Lead → Revenue Cycle Supervisor. This role builds payment posting, denials, and revenue cycle skills.
